name: EmberSign
subtitle: On-device signing and tweak injection

apps.name: EmberSign
apps.subtitle: Apple Accounts, IPA signing and JIT tools
apps.localizedDescription: EmberSign signs IPAs using imported certificates or Apple Account provisioning, supports multiple saved Apple Accounts, compatible tweak injection, pairing-file management, JIT preparation, paired-device app inventory, best-effort app refresh, Apple Watch IPA signing-target inspection, and error diagnostics with online lookup. Watch installation is not yet supported. Apple services and background refresh require device testing; a pairing tunnel is needed for installed-app inventory.
